item.title: Re: The Sanctum
item.content:encoded:
Thx for the feedback it's really helpful and appreciated.

In terms of how the Sanctum has remained hidden, it's because they acted in secrecy on par with the foundation, the Star of Bethlehem (SOB) guiding them to anomalies before the foundation can get to them. Another main reason is because of the heavy self-isolation the Sanctum has, it didn't know the foundation existed. It wasn't until the foundation became fully efficient that they were able to track and find anomalies just as fast as the Sanctum and the two eventually clashed leading to the vanishing agents, and later the Sanctum's discovery.

In terms of relations with other GoI, the Sanctum worked in heavy secrecy and mainly operated inside of Italy and Europe so its existence is almost unknown to the whole world aside from the Foundation when it's uncovered. But the foundation does find members of the Serpent's Hand contained within the prison, but the Serpent's hand are unaware of who was responsible.

item.title: Re: The Sanctum
item.content:encoded:
metaldragonx1 here.
There are some things I would want to say regarding this idea.
The first is that this actually wouldn't be an SCP article as it primarily details a counterpart to the SCP Foundation, a GUI. I mentioned this because you list SCP article as the page type. If you want for the prison itself to be an SCP (which in it's own right would be a good idea), then this would make more sense.
Likewise, there will need to be some explation as why it took a while for the Foundation to discover the Sanction's existence. (Where they using something to cloak themselves?).
For further lore, you could also mention other GUI's and indicate their relationship with the Sanctum (optional, but it can bring in more readers). Likely since you say the Sanctum protects the world, maybe they become allies with the Foundation? (Also optional).
I hope this critique helps out. If you would like any further advice, you message me and I'll be glad to answer any more questions.

item.title: The Sanctum
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: GoI format/Potential for separate SCP article on the prison and the Star of Bethlehem.

Genre: History, Horror, Action

Page Layout: GoI format/SCP article + addendums.

Elevator Pitch: Numerous SCPs undocumented by the foundation is located in the most unlikely place, The Vatican City. Beneath the city lies a 300-meter deep prison protected by powerful Templars, and priests known as Arminda's. The ancient prison contains SCPs via 'blessings' granted by the 'Star of Bethlehem' a large light orb at the top of the prison, which in itself is it's own SCP.

Central Narrative:When foundation agents in Italy begin to vanish and remerge memoryless. The foundation is led to Vatican City.

+ Further Narrative
- Title for hiding text

To understand the cause of this, the foundation sent in an infiltration unit into the Vatican to watch for bizarre activity. Upon entering, the squad found nothing out of the ordinary, until they witnessed a man in white robes wall through a large display waterfall and vanish. The foundation now had proof of anomalous activity.

Concerned for a potential hostile threat, the SCP foundation conducted a full investigation into the activity. Including a squad sent to contain the white-robed priest- but yet again the squad failed to return, no bodies, no trace. Eventually, the foundation launched a full raid on the Vatican, and what they would uncover was The Sanctum, the Vatican's very own SCP Foundation, home to over 300 undocumented SCPs. In the center was a large pit traveling down 300 meters, and above was a bright ball of light that appeared to light the whole prison.

Upon entering, the foundation made contact with those who ran this facility. Ancient knights known as the Templars, and white-robed priests known as Armindas. Attempting to force entry brought hostility, and a fight broke out between the strike team and The Templars, who despite wielding only armor, swords, and shields, dispatched enough foundation units to force a retreat. From this point, The Sanctum is declared an enemy of The Foundation.

The story continues as the foundation attempts to decide whether to take the Sanctum by force or attempt to negotiate and uncover all of its secrets.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I believe the idea has a lot of potentials to introduce new things the foundation never knew existed and uncover the true power that the Sanctum holds, and how it and the Foundation tetters on war or peace with each other. And the secret of what lies at the bottom of the prison, along with finding out how and why the Sanctum does such things.
